title: Additive first integral root transport
statement: An auxiliary categorical statement for the first completed root-line transport.

proof.text: The chosen finite root maps are componentwise isomorphisms, and inverse image along g preserves the root-tower limit. Thus the specified r is an isomorphism. Construct the additive discrete tensor comparison phi with its pure-tensor formula and discrete O_E linearity.

The completed root scalar identity gives semilinearity on integral pure tensors for the image of completed Z_l scalars. The discrete formula gives semilinearity for the image of O_E. Every completed integral coefficient is an image of a tensor in B tensor_A R, by purTwistCoefficientTensor. Tensor induction, additivity and the multiplicative action law combine the two generator cases and prove semilinearity on every pure root tensor for arbitrary completed scalars.

An integral tensor sheaf section locally comes from a raw sectionwise tensor. Pull back the scalar and section to this covering sieve; naturality of phi, of the coefficient map and of the completed action reduces the equality there to tensor induction. The pure case was proved above, and zero and addition follow from module/additive laws. Sheaf separatedness gives semilinearity on every section. Specialize to 1 tensor x, use the discrete pure-tensor formula and preservation of 1 by the constant ring comparison to obtain the first formula. Together with invertibility this proves the original statement unchanged.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean construction, completed-scalar tensor induction and local sheafification descent.

lean.statement:
theorem frobeniusIntegralRootTransport_additive
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (r : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (purTwistZlOne Y l) ⟶ purTwistZlOne X l)
    (hr : r = limit.post (proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower Y l Fact.out)
        (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ≫
      lim.map (((proEtaleRootsOfUnityInverseImageIso g).2.1 l Fact.out).choose)) :
    ∃ φ : (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (purTwistIntegralModule Y l E) ⟶
      (proEtaleSheafDirectImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (purTwistIntegralModule X l E)),
      IsIso φ ∧
      (∀ (V : Y.ProEt) (a : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E Y).obj.obj
          (op V)) (x : (purTwistZlOne Y l).obj.obj (op V)),
        φ.hom.app (op V)
          (@SMul.smul _ _ (purTwistIntegralAction Y l E (op V)).toSMul a
            (purTwistIntegralTensor Y l E (op V) 1 x)) =
        @SMul.smul _ _
          (purTwistIntegralAction X l E (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))).toSMul
          ((sfCompletedCoefficientMap l E g).hom.app (op V) a)
          (purTwistIntegralTensor X l E (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)) 1
            (r.hom.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
            (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).unit.app
              (purTwistZlOne Y l)).hom.app (op V) x)))) ∧
      (∀ (V : Y.ProEt) (a : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E Y).obj.obj
          (op V)) (t : (purTwistIntegralModule Y l E).val.obj (op V)),
        φ.hom.app (op V)
          (@SMul.smul _ _ (purTwistIntegralAction Y l E (op V)).toSMul a t) =
        @SMul.smul _ _
          (purTwistIntegralAction X l E (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))).toSMul
          ((sfCompletedCoefficientMap l E g).hom.app (op V) a)
          (φ.hom.app (op V) t))
